name: Screenshot Clip
author: Pablo Nicolás Marín
description: Print Screen copies to the clipboard instead of filling ~/Pictures. A floating card lets you save, edit or close each screenshot, and the bar keeps your recent ones until reboot.

barWidget.description: Recent screenshots kept in memory: save, edit, copy or delete them

schema.label: Language
schema.description: auto follows the system locale; en and es force English or Spanish.

schema.label: Card stays for (seconds)
schema.description: How long the card stays after a capture. It pauses while the pointer is over it. 2 to 30.

schema.label: Recent screenshots to keep
schema.description: Temporary copies kept in memory for the panel. They are cleared on reboot. 1 to 50.

schema.label: Use Print Screen
schema.description: Bind Print Screen to Screenshot Clip. Turn off to keep Omarchy's own screenshot on that key.
